scope: Source and exact resource compilation only; no standalone ELF, Arena, model integration or quantizer change
prior_proof: ops_int4_pack_words and i4_raw_adapter in int4-raw-binding proved B16 H3840 only; this is a fresh full-P512 geometry/blocked-layout gate
input: Ordinary canonical I32[P512,K], codes in [-8,7], K=H3840 or L15360; canonical I32 quantizer output is a distinct owning buffer
packing: Mask15, shift by4*(K%8), exact AddSat reduction of eight disjoint fields, pairwise TU compaction into dense I32 words; every signed partial sum is within I32 bounds

mapping.byte_offset: ((((p/256)*(K/960)+k/960)*256+p%256)*960+k%960)/2; even k low nibble, odd k high nibble
mapping.conversion: Real DMA store from canonical packed DM to blocked HBM; all conversion work stays inside the pack resource. No unsafe reshape, tensor dtype cast or omitted per-request layout transfer

consumer_contract.proof_reader: Typed blocked-I4 to canonical-I4 byte copy, both H and L; normal typed call and public Function::run over packed I32 owner must agree with independent CPU canonical/blocked nibble encoders
consumer_contract.limit: Reader verifies owner/raw ABI/byte layout only; no new GEMM, per960 scale or complete FFN equivalence claim

resources.failure_rule: Preserve failed full-P512 source/schedule. No substitution of B16 estimate; only report a concrete P128 boundary and its launch cost if whole-shape allocation fails

probe_source: Independent pair-of-nibbles byte encoder versus eight-field word encoder; all16 top nibbles, signed endpoints, zeros, distinct row/shard coordinates, true row/channel permutations; whole packed/canonical bytes and immutable inputs/shifts, exact-owner extents/alignment/overlap validation
ownership: Packed I32 owner retained immutable across awaited raw call; output is a distinct owning HbmTensor. Public Buffers clones remain local through completion; no fabricated address or private SDK binding
build_policy: Original Cargo and lock, incremental0/debug0, tail256-model target exclusive, unique public FURIOSA_OPT_OUT_DIR for resource builds; disk3.2GiB at start, no deletions
not_claimed: No weight quantization or activation math change
